entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: The realm Gustha served and sided with against Lim-Dûl.

events.summary: Gustha joins her cousin Gerda's conspiracy letting Lim-Dûl capture Jodah and take him to Tresserhorn, receiving the Reflecting Mirror.
events.quote: Gustha was in on her cousin Gerda's conspiracy that allowed Lim-Dûl to capture Jodah and bring him to Tresserhorn

events.summary: Jaya Ballard steals the Reflecting Mirror back.
events.quote: which was later stolen back by Jaya Ballard

events.summary: Gustha makes amends with Jodah and sides with Kjeldor against Lim-Dûl.
Gustha dies a hero's death, swarmed by undead after exhausting her spells against a warded Avram Garrisson.
events.quote: She ended up dying a hero's death during Lim-Dûl's Battle .

relations.quote: arguing with her cousin, Gerda Äagesdotter
She led the Royal Academy of Magic in Krov and was known as a strict leader.
Gustha Ebbasdotter was the royal mage of Kjeldor at the time of the Ice Age of Dominaria .
